channel.title: Bloomberg — diagnostic source feed
channel.description: Diagnostic feed grouped by acquisition connector.

item.title: Kioxia Plans New Chip Facility in Japan to Meet AI Memory Demand
item.description: Kioxia Holdings Corp. is building a new fabrication facility at its manufacturing site in Japan’s northern prefecture of Iwate, people familiar with the matter said, ratcheting up production capacity to meet sustained AI-related demand for storage.
item.dc:creator: Takashi Mochizuki and Hideki Suzuki

item.title: Nvidia Predicts AI-fueled Sales Surge Will Extend Into 2028
item.description: Nvidia, the chipmaker at the heart of the artificial intelligence boom, gave a bullish sales outlook for fiscal 2028, easing concerns that AI spending is poised to lose momentum. Ed Ludlow breaks down the company's Q2 earnings. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Nvidia Steps Back Into China Market With First H200 Chip Sales
item.description: Nvidia Corp. said it sold a small number of its H200 chips to customers in China during the most recent quarter, though shipments of the artificial intelligence processors to the world’s second-largest economy fell short of the total permitted with the blessing of US President Donald Trump.
item.dc:creator: Maggie Eastland

item.title: Musk’s X Suit Against New York Over Hate-Speech Data Dismissed
item.description: A judge dismissed a suit by Elon Musk’s X Corp. that sought to block a New York law requiring social media companies to disclose how they deal with hate speech, extremism and disinformation, ruling that “the First Amendment poses no obstacle” to the law.
item.dc:creator: Bob Van Voris

item.title: Muted Inflation Advance Offers Fed Breathing Room Ahead of Jackson Hole Symposium
item.description: Meera Pandit, Executive Director and Global Market Strategist at JPMorgan Asset Management, discussed the recent muted increase in personal consumption expenditures and its implications for Federal Reserve policy. With core inflation at 3.3%, above the 2% target but far below the highs seen in previous years, the Fed faces a dilemma on whether to raise rates further. She speaks with Romaine Bostick & Emily Graffeo on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Brazil Seeks $97 Million From App Discord Over User Protections
item.description: Brazil’s government is seeking 500 million reais ($97.1 million) in damages from chat app Discord Inc. in a local lawsuit, while also demanding that the platform strengthen protections for children and women and comply with Brazilian law.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Carvalho

item.title: DataBank’s Incoming CEO on AI Buildout, Nvidia Earnings
item.description: Kevin Ooley, the incoming CEO of DataBank and current CFO, joined the program to discuss critical issues surrounding the expansion of data centers. Operating over 70 data centers across more than 25 markets, DataBank faces significant challenges related to power availability and infrastructure. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Mandeep Singh on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: ‘Dean of Valuation’ Damodaran on Nvidia’s Multiple
item.description: Aswath Damodaran, Professor of Finance at NYU Stern School of Business, discusses the evolving landscape of AI investments following Nvidia's latest earnings report. He describes the current phase as AI's "bar mitzvah moment," where investors are shifting from valuing companies based on future promises to requiring concrete evidence of progress. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Mandeep Singh on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Nvidia Investor Jack Ablin on Earnings Results, Guidance
item.description: Jack Ablin, Founding Partner and Chief Investment Strategist at Cresset, a $260 billion family office, joined the discussion to provide insights on Nvidia's recent stock performance. Ablin also touched on Nvidia’s recent earnings report and a significant data center lease agreement with terms of 15 years, indicating strong business fundamentals supporting the company's outlook.. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Nvidia Results Impress, But Shares Fall | The Close 8/26/2026
item.description: Bloomberg Television brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Northwestern Mutual Wealth Chief Portfolio Manager, Equities Matt Stucky, JPMorgan Asset Management Executive Director, Global Market Strategist Meera Pandit, Telsey Advisory Group CEO Dana Telsey, NYU Emeritus Professor, Psychology and Neural Science Gary Marcus, Gabelli Funds Portfolio Manager & Managing Director for Growth Portfolios John Belton, AOL Co-Founder Steve Case, Seaport Research Partners Semiconductors & Electronics Senior Analyst Jay Goldberg, Cressent Founding Partner & Chief Investment Strategist Jack Ablin, NYU Professor Stern School of Business Professor Aswath Damodaran, DataBank Incoming CEO Kevin Ooley, & Council on Foreign Relations Senior Fellow for China Chris McGuire. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Tech Billionaire Steve Case on AI Buildout, Nvidia Role
item.description: Steve Case, Revolution Chair & CEO, & AOL Co-Founder, reflects on the evolution of community building from the early days of AOL's digital chat rooms to today's increasing demand for real-world connections. He highlights how the rise of AI and digital interactions has sparked renewed interest and investment in physical communities, particularly in real estate and hospitality sectors. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Unrivaled Valuation, Oura IPO, Data Center Backlash | Bloomberg Deals 8/26/2026
item.description: A weekly, midday program that delivers high-impact, editorially driven coverage of the most important corporate transactions shaping the global market. Today's guests: Jason Greenberg, Jeffries Global Head of Investment Banking Strategy, Maria Goodpaster, Partner at McKinsey & Company, Kate Dorsey, Managing Director at Stonepeak, Melissa Kalka, M&A, Private Equity Partner at Kirkland & Ellis, and Alex Bazzell, Unrivaled CEO & Co-Founder. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Meta’s $18 Billion Social Media Settlement by the Numbers
item.description: Meta Platforms Inc.’s plan to pay up to $18 billion in a sweeping settlement with almost every US state will resolve a slew of legal claims related to teenage users on the company’s social media platforms.
item.dc:creator: Madlin Mekelburg

item.title: Revolution CEO Steve Case Says AI Driving Shift to Durable Assets
item.description: Revolution CEO Steve Case says AI will disrupt a wide range of industries and business models, advising investors to seek assets that have better durability. Speaking with Romaine Bostick on "Bloomberg's The Close," Case points to real estate and hospitality as areas attracting investment. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Meta’s Monumental Settlement
item.description: Finally, what some said could never be done has happened: Meta has been forced to make real changes to protect the millions of young people who use its products. While the amount that the company agreed to pay to settle a lawsuit brought by several states — up to $18 billion — is large, the real impact of the settlement may lie in what other social media apps do next, Bloomberg Opinion Dave Lee says. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: AI Expert on Anthropic’s “Fantasy” Projections, Nvidia
item.description: Gary Marcus, NYU Emeritus Professor of Psychology and Neural Science, discusses the recently rumored total addressable market (TAM) figures presented by AI companies like Anthropic, which suggest a market size comparable to the entire U.S. GDP. He expresses skepticism about the realism of such enormous valuations and market opportunities, noting that while AI impacts many areas, not everyone is using or satisfied with it. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Emily Graffeo on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: UK Starts Selling Plug-In Solar Panels at Argos to Lower Bills
item.description: The UK will become the latest European country to sell plug-in solar panels, with Argos Ltd. and UKSOL Ltd. offering them as early as Thursday and other shops following in the coming weeks.
item.dc:creator: Jessica Shankleman

item.title: Nvidia Predicts AI-Fueled Sales Surge Will Extend Into 2028
item.description: Nvidia Corp., the chipmaker at the heart of the artificial intelligence boom, gave a bullish sales outlook for fiscal 2028, easing concerns that AI spending is poised to lose momentum.
item.dc:creator: Ian King

item.title: CrowdStrike Shares Soar After Sales Outlook Beats Estimates
item.description: CrowdStrike Holdings Inc.’s shares jumped in late trading after the company projected revenue for the full year that exceeded analysts’ estimates, evidence that the cybersecurity industry continues to benefit from AI-fueled demand.
item.dc:creator: Jake Bleiberg

item.title: Salesforce Gains on Growth Outlook, Anthropic Partnership
item.description: Salesforce Inc. jumped in extended trading after the software company gave an outlook for strong revenue expansion and deepened its partnership with Anthropic PBC, reassuring investors that it can compete successfully in the AI era.
item.dc:creator: Brody Ford
